# Hare meat

Type: Material | Internal ID: HareMeat | Source: Hare | Usage: Cooking station, ,, Food preparation table | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Hare meat is a food dropped by Hares. It can be cooked on a Cooking station or Iron cooking station to obtain Cooked hare meat or Coal if overcooked. It can be crafted into other foods using the Food preparation table.

## Availability

• Creature: Hare | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

### Crafting

• Cooked hare meat
• Coal, if left on a Cooking station for too long
• Misthare supreme (from Uncooked misthare supreme)
• Meat platter (from Uncooked meat platter)
Cooked hare meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Hare meat as ingredient.

## Notes

• Misthare supreme provides the highest amount of Health of all food items in the Mistlands, and requires only easily-farmable Jotun puffs and Carrots in addition to the Hare meat.

Categorias: Materials, Food
